description: This Java class defines a specific type of business event related to loan chargeback transactions within the Apache Fineract project. It extends the LoanTransactionBusinessEvent class and specifies event-related constants and behavior for handling chargeback events on loans.

classes.name: LoanChargebackTransactionBusinessEvent
classes.description: Represents a business event triggered when a loan chargeback transaction occurs. Extends LoanTransactionBusinessEvent to specify details pertinent to chargeback events.

methods.name: LoanChargebackTransactionBusinessEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with the specific loan transaction to be charged back.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this type of business event.
